extras: Desktop only. Network requests only occur during export to build offline embed cards (YouTube, Twitter). Link-only mode reduces discoverability but is not access control.
intentEvidence: Export selected Obsidian content — including Bases views — to a self-contained, offline-readable static website.
problem: Sharing complex Obsidian content, especially Bases views, outside the app environment is difficult and often requires online hosting.
summary: VaultPack exports selected Obsidian content, including Bases views, into a self-contained, offline-readable static website format.
